summoning_condition.en: This card's name becomes "Revival of Sennen Genjin" while in the Graveyard.

effect.en: Ritual Summon "Sengenjin" or "The Unstoppable Sengenjin" by sending face-up EARTH Attribute monsters from your field to the Graveyard whose total Levels equal 8 or more as material (you cannot use more monsters than necessary as material). This turn, you can only attack with EARTH Attribute monsters.
